items.text: Minnesota (Wed): DNP - WR Jordan Addison (thumb surgery, out coming weeks, no IR for now), QB Kyler Murray (hamstring). LIMITED - TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist), OLB Andrew Van Ginkel (quad), OLB Kyle Van Noy (calf), S Jay Ward (knee). Full - LB Blake Cashman (likely clears protocol), WR Jauan Jennings. IR - G Donovan Jackson. Kirk Cousins starts.

San Francisco (Wed, game in Mexico City): DNP - WR Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis, missed 3 weeks), LB Dre Greenlaw (neck); RB Christian McCaffrey and LT Trent Williams rest. LIMITED - S Ji'Ayir Brown (ankle), CB Renardo Green (back), CB Upton Stout. CB Nate Hobbs full. Brock Purdy starts.
